articles.excerpt: External sandboxes for coding agents I've been exploring new ways to sandbox code that is executed by agents, with a focus on making it safer to try out local models without worrying that a mistake or prompt injection attack might cause them to take damaging actions on a machine. I worked on this project with Prime Radiant , the AI research lab behind Superpowers and other projects . My post on the Prime Radiant blog introduces the external sandbox pattern, where code executed by the agent runs inside a dedicated sandbox while the agent itself lives outside of that sandbox. To demonstrate this pattern we've released three sandbox server implementations: external-sandbox-v86 runs a Node.js server which then uses v86 to run Alpine Linux inside WebAssembly. external-sandbox-container is a Python web server which runs the sandbox in Alpine Linux inside an Apple Containers instance. external-sandbox-quicksand is another Python web server, this time using Microsoft's Quicksand sandboxing library, which bundles QEMU and Alpine Linux in a Python package! Each of these implementations offers the same localhost API. You can then configure Pi, Claude Code, or Codex to send API calls to that sandbox any time they want to execute code. The sandboxes also include an optional HTTP/HTTPS allow-list proxy, so you can control exactly which hosts your agent's code is allowed to communicate with - plus a credential replacement mechanism to make authenticated API calls without sharing a secret…
articles.summary: Simon Willison présente un pattern de « bac à sable externe » pour agents de code : le code exécuté par l'agent tourne dans une sandbox dédiée, séparée de l'agent, afin de limiter les dégâts d'une erreur ou d'une injection de prompt, surtout avec des modèles locaux. Trois implémentations serveur sont publiées (v86 avec Alpine Linux en WebAssembly, conteneur Apple, et Quicksand de Microsoft basé sur QEMU), offrant la même API localhost, avec un proxy optionnel à liste d'hôtes autorisés et un mécanisme de remplacement d'identifiants.
articles.title: External sandboxes for coding agents

articles.excerpt: Purpose CISA strongly urges organizations to immediately patch the recently disclosed Oracle Java vulnerability CVE-2026-114938 . This critical memory-corruption vulnerability, known as “Java4Shell,” affects the Base64 decoder of the x86-64 HotSpot Java Virtual Machine (JVM), which is part of the Java Development Kit (JDK). Specially crafted Base64 input could crash the JVM and allow for unauthenticated remote code execution. Actions to take CISA urges organizations to take the following actions: Identify affected Java installations. Review your software inventory for JDKs and Java runtimes, including those bundled with third-party applications or included in container images and appliances. Note: JDKs and Java runtimes may not appear as separate entries in software inventories. Apply relevant Java and vendor patches as soon as they are available, prioritizing internet-facing systems. If immediate patching is not feasible, implement temporary compensating controls, such as restricting and validating Base64 input at the application boundary, enforcing input-size limits, and limiting unauthenticated access. Review Oracle’s security advisory for guidance on patching and affected products and versions. Monitor for indicators of suspicious activity, including rogue runtimes, unexpected JVM crashes, and suspicious Java processes. Resources CISA urges network defenders to review the following resource and apply necessary updates: Vendor Guidance Oracle’s Security Advisory…
articles.group_summary: Une faille critique de corruption de mémoire dans le décodeur Base64 de Java permet l'exécution de code à distance sans authentification, touchant des applications comme Jenkins, Jira et Keycloak. Binding Operational Directive (BOD) 26-04: Prioritizing Security Updates Based on Risk establishes vulnerability management requirements for Federal Civilian Executive Branch (FCEB) agencies. BOD 26-04 reinforces the importance of the KEV Catalog and requires federal agencies to prioritize rapid remediation of high-risk vulnerabilities, specifically those identified by Common Vulnerabilities and Exposures (CVEs) listed in CISA’s KEV Catalog on publicly exposed assets that grant total control of the asset post-exploitation, while deferring action for lower-risk vulnerabilities. BOD 26-04 further establishes basic expectations for when agencies must check whether threat actors compromised the system before the patch was applied. While BOD 26-04 applies only to FCEB agencies, CISA encourages all organizations to adopt risk-based vulnerability management and prioritize remediation of KEV Catalog vulnerabilities . CISA will continue to add vulnerabilities to the catalog that meet the specified criteria . Aware of an exploited vulnerability not currently listed in the KEV Catalog? Submit it for potential addition through…

articles.excerpt: Starting today, Amazon Relational Database Service (Amazon RDS) for MySQL supports MySQL minor version 8.4.13, the latest minor released by community MySQL. We recommend upgrading to the newer minor versions to accept fixes for Common Vulnerabilities and Exposures (CVEs) in prior versions of MySQL and to benefit from bug fixes, performance improvements, and new functionality added by the MySQL community. Learn more about the enhancements in RDS for MySQL 8.4.13 in the Amazon RDS user guide and MySQL 8.4.13 release notes. You can upgrade your databases during scheduled maintenance windows using automatic minor version upgrades. To simplify operations at scale, enable automatic minor version upgrades and use the AWS Organizations Upgrade Rollout Policy to orchestrate upgrades across your instances in phases, validating on lower-priority environments before upgrading your most critical ones. You can perform minor version upgrades in-place or via snapshot restore. Learn more about performing version upgrades in the Amazon RDS User Guide . This release is supported in all AWS Regions where Amazon RDS for MySQL is available. Amazon RDS for MySQL makes it simple to set up, operate, and scale MySQL deployments in the cloud. Create or update a fully managed Amazon RDS database in the Amazon RDS Management Console or by using the AWS Command Line Interface (AWS CLI).
articles.summary: Amazon RDS for MySQL prend en charge la version mineure 8.4.13 de MySQL, la plus récente publiée par la communauté MySQL. AWS recommande la mise à niveau pour corriger des vulnérabilités (CVE) des versions antérieures et profiter de correctifs et d'améliorations de performance, la mise à niveau pouvant se faire pendant les fenêtres de maintenance planifiées ou via une restauration de snapshot, dans toutes les régions où le service est offert.
articles.title: Amazon RDS for MySQL supports MySQL minor version 8.4.13

articles.excerpt: Amazon Cognito now supports point-in-time recovery (PITR), so you can restore the user data in a user pool to an earlier time. Amazon Cognito helps you implement secure sign-in and access control for users, AI agents, and microservices. Previously, you had to build and maintain your own export and restore process, and restored users received new identifiers and had to reset their passwords. With PITR, you choose a recovery point, preview how many users, groups, multi-factor authentication (MFA) settings, and passkeys the recovery will create, update, or delete, and then start or cancel the recovery. Recovered users keep their identifiers, passwords, MFA settings, and passkeys, so they can sign in without resetting their credentials. For example, if a script deletes or modifies users by mistake, you can restore the user data to the moment before it ran. PITR is enabled automatically for user pools on the Essentials and Plus feature plans at no additional charge. The recovery window is up to 1 day on Essentials and up to 14 days on Plus. You can initiate and manage a recovery using the AWS Management Console, the Amazon Cognito API, AWS Command Line Interface (AWS CLI), or AWS SDKs. PITR is available in all AWS Regions where Amazon Cognito is available. To learn more, see Point-in-time recovery in the Amazon Cognito Developer Guide.
articles.summary: Amazon Cognito permet désormais de restaurer les données utilisateurs d'un user pool à un moment antérieur grâce à la récupération ponctuelle (PITR). Les utilisateurs restaurés conservent leurs identifiants, mots de passe, paramètres MFA et passkeys, sans avoir à réinitialiser leurs identifiants. La fonction est activée automatiquement sans frais supplémentaires pour les plans Essentials (jusqu'à 1 jour) et Plus (jusqu'à 14 jours), et est disponible dans toutes les régions où Cognito est offert.
articles.title: Amazon Cognito now supports point-in-time recovery

articles.excerpt: Amazon RDS now initializes storage volumes faster when you perform a point-in-time restore (PITR), create a read replica, or convert a Single-AZ instance to Multi-AZ. Each of these operations creates storage volumes from a snapshot, and the data blocks are downloaded from Amazon S3 before you can access them. With fast storage volume initialization, you get a fully performant DB instance in a predictable amount of time. Previously, the initialization rate varied with your workload and with which blocks were accessed. As there was no dedicated bandwidth, so you could see increased I/O latency and had no way to tell when an instance would reach full performance. Now, each database instance is initialized at up to 4 TiB per hour, across every gp3 and io2 storage volume attached to the instance. If concurrent initialization across your account exceeds the available bandwidth, the remaining blocks initialize on a best-effort basis, so initialization is never slower than today. Your DB instance stays available and usable while initialization runs. Fast storage volume initialization is enabled by default and no action is required. To follow progress, use the StorageOperationStatus and StorageOperationPercentProgress fields in the Amazon RDS console, the DescribeDBInstances API, the AWS Command Line Interface (CLI), or AWS SDKs. This capability is available at no additional cost for RDS for MariaDB, RDS for MySQL, RDS for PostgreSQL, RDS for Db2, RDS for Microsoft SQL Server, and…
articles.summary: Amazon RDS initialise désormais plus rapidement les volumes de stockage lors d'une restauration à un point dans le temps, de la création d'un réplica en lecture ou de la conversion d'une instance Single-AZ en Multi-AZ, avec une vitesse pouvant atteindre 4 TiB par heure et par instance. Cette fonctionnalité est activée par défaut, sans frais supplémentaires, et l'instance reste disponible pendant l'initialisation. La progression se suit via les champs StorageOperationStatus et StorageOperationPercentProgress.
articles.title: Amazon RDS now supports fast storage volume initialization

articles.excerpt: AWS Control Tower now lets you use an existing Amazon S3 bucket in your landing zone to store AWS Config and AWS CloudTrail logs. Previously, AWS Control Tower required you to use the Amazon S3 bucket it creates and manages for log storage. Now, customers who want full control of bucket policies, lifecycle rules, and logging infrastructure can consolidate centralized logs in an Amazon S3 bucket they already manage. You can use your own Amazon S3 bucket for both AWS Config and AWS CloudTrail, giving you full control of bucket policies, lifecycle rules, and logging infrastructure. You can switch between self-managed and AWS Control Tower managed buckets at any time, and your Amazon S3 buckets are preserved during landing zone updates, resets, and decommissioning. The bucket must be owned by an AWS account in your organization, be located in your AWS Control Tower home Region, and be preconfigured with the bucket policy that AWS Control Tower requires. This feature is supported in landing zone version 4.0 and later and is available in all commercial AWS Regions , the AWS GovCloud (US) Regions, and the AWS European Sovereign Cloud where AWS Control Tower is available. To learn more about configuring self-managed Amazon S3 bucket for your AWS Control Tower landing zone, visit the AWS Control Tower documentation .
articles.summary: AWS Control Tower permet désormais d'utiliser un bucket Amazon S3 existant de la landing zone pour stocker les journaux AWS Config et AWS CloudTrail, au lieu du bucket créé et géré automatiquement par le service. Le bucket doit appartenir à un compte de l'organisation, se trouver dans la Région d'origine de Control Tower et avoir la politique de bucket requise. La fonctionnalité exige la landing zone version 4.0 ou ultérieure et est offerte dans les Régions commerciales, GovCloud (US) et la région européenne souveraine où Control Tower est disponible.
articles.title: AWS Control Tower now supports existing Amazon S3 bucket for log delivery

articles.excerpt: Amazon WorkSpaces Applications now supports smart card redirection on single-session and multi-session fleets, so users can access the smart card connected to their local device from applications inside their streaming session. It also extends smart card sign-in, previously limited to single-session fleets, to multi-session fleets. This launch helps public sector, healthcare, and other regulated organizations that use Common Access Card (CAC) or Personal Identity Verification (PIV) cards run those workflows on multi-session fleets. Administrators can turn smart card sign-in for Active Directory and smart card redirection on or off independently for each stack. Smart card sign-in lets users sign in to domain-joined streaming instances with their smart card instead of a password, while redirected smart cards support in-session authentication, digital signing, and email encryption. For example, a government agency can move CAC users from single-session to multi-session fleets and keep CAC sign-in. These capabilities are available today in all AWS commercial and AWS GovCloud (US) regions that offer WorkSpaces Applications. To get started, turn on either setting under User settings for your stack, use a Windows image with the latest WorkSpaces Applications agent, and connect with the WorkSpaces Applications client for Windows. New stacks have both settings turned off by default, and existing stacks that use smart card redirection keep it turned on. To learn more, see Create a…
articles.summary: Amazon WorkSpaces Applications prend désormais en charge la redirection des cartes à puce sur les parcs monosession et multisession, permettant aux applications de la session de streaming d'utiliser la carte branchée sur l'appareil local. L'ouverture de session par carte à puce, auparavant limitée aux parcs monosession, est aussi étendue aux parcs multisession, ce qui profite notamment aux organisations réglementées utilisant des cartes CAC ou PIV. Les administrateurs peuvent activer ou désactiver chacune de ces options indépendamment pour chaque pile, et ces fonctions sont disponibles dans toutes les régions commerciales AWS et AWS GovCloud (US) offrant le service.
articles.title: Amazon WorkSpaces Applications adds support for smart card redirection

articles.excerpt: Amazon EMR 8.2 is now available with new features across Amazon EMR on EC2, Amazon EMR on EKS, and Amazon EMR Serverless. This release upgrades Apache Spark to 4.1.3, Apache Iceberg to 1.11.0, and Delta Lake to 4.2.0, and it is designated a Long Term Support (LTS) release. This release makes it easier to run secure, governed analytics at scale — you can now write to the same Delta Lake table on Amazon S3 from multiple clusters concurrently, refresh Iceberg materialized views incrementally, and propagate end-user identity from Spark jobs and interactive sessions all the way to AWS Lake Formation and Amazon S3 so access is authorized and audited as the original user. Amazon EMR 8.2 expands governance and performance across all three deployment options. New features include concurrent Delta Lake writes using Amazon S3 conditional writes (no DynamoDB log store required), and Lake Formation fine-grained access control (FGAC) now covers materialized views, governed user-defined functions, more Iceberg operations, and a broader set of Spark SQL features. The release also adds OpenLineage-based lineage capture to the AWS Glue Data Catalog and trusted identity propagation for steps and sessions. With EMR 8.2, data engineers can now precompute each pipeline stage as an Iceberg materialized view in SQL. Each materialized view refreshes only the changes instead of recomputing the entire source table across projections, inner joins, filters and SUM, COUNT aggregations. Specific to EMR…
articles.summary: Amazon EMR 8.2 est disponible sur EC2, EKS et Serverless, avec des mises à jour vers Apache Spark 4.1.3, Apache Iceberg 1.11.0 et Delta Lake 4.2.0, et il est désigné comme version à support à long terme (LTS). Cette version permet l'écriture simultanée sur une même table Delta Lake dans Amazon S3 depuis plusieurs clusters, ainsi que le rafraîchissement incrémentiel des vues matérialisées Iceberg. Elle étend aussi le contrôle d'accès granulaire de Lake Formation et la propagation de l'identité utilisateur jusqu'à S3.
articles.title: Amazon EMR 8.2 is now available

articles.excerpt: Amazon EMR Serverless now offers the Apache Spark optimization agent, which analyzes completed Spark job runs and delivers cost and performance optimization recommendations in seconds. You can select a cost or performance goal, and the agent returns specific configuration changes with the telemetry evidence and plain-language reasoning behind each suggestion. The agent can analyze a single run or compare it against a known-good baseline to pinpoint what changed. You access it from the EMR Serverless console or through the SageMaker Unified Studio MCP Server. The agent takes the job's configuration, logs, and Spark telemetry together with your chosen intent and returns recommendations computed by a deterministic recommendation engine. The engine reads all job artifacts together to identify what is driving runtime and cost: too little parallelism, a skewed join key, memory pressure forcing spill, idle executors, or capacity provisioned beyond what the job uses. The configurations the engine targets are the settings most commonly tuned across millions of Spark jobs running on AWS. When cost and performance trade off, the recommendation improves the metric you asked for while keeping degradation of the other within defined limits. The engine also evaluates a best practices checklist covering platform-level improvements such as upgrading to a newer Spark version or using Graviton processors. Each recommendation is labeled by the surface it modifies: infrastructure, Spark…
articles.summary: AWS lance l'agent d'optimisation Apache Spark pour Amazon EMR Serverless, qui analyse les exécutions Spark terminées et propose des recommandations de coût ou de performance selon l'objectif choisi. Chaque suggestion de configuration est accompagnée des données de télémétrie et d'un raisonnement en langage clair, et l'agent peut comparer une exécution à une référence connue. Il est accessible depuis la console EMR Serverless ou via le serveur MCP de SageMaker Unified Studio.
articles.title: Introducing the Apache Spark Optimization Agent for Amazon EMR Serverless

articles.excerpt: AWS Partners can now expedite Migration Acceleration Program (MAP) deals, from qualification to incentive payout, with an end-to-end agentic workflow in AWS Transform. Partners can manage the full MAP lifecycle without leaving AWS Transform, including deal qualification, funding approvals, agreement execution, migration planning and execution, resource tagging, and incentive disbursement. Previously, Partners had to switch between separate systems for opportunity discovery, assessments, deal qualification, funding approvals, agreement execution, resource tagging, and incentive disbursement. This fragmentation, along with manual handoffs between steps, led to longer qualification cycles. Now, with the agentic MAP experience in AWS Transform, Partners connect their AWS Partner Central account and invite customers into the same engagement. Partners start by scoping customer environments with the built-in agentic discovery tool, or by importing data from RVTools or AWS-validated ISV tools listed in AWS Marketplace. AWS Transform then combines this discovery data with opportunity details from APN Customer Engagements (ACE) to automatically qualify Partner-initiated opportunities in a guided flow, so Partners get eligibility decisions sooner and close deals faster. As the migration progresses, MAP resource tags are applied automatically, and Partner cash and customer credits are disbursed based on actual usage data. Throughout, customers get shared, real-time visibility into…
articles.summary: AWS Transform permet désormais aux partenaires AWS de gérer l'intégralité du cycle de vie des projets MAP (Migration Acceleration Program), de la qualification de l'affaire au versement de la prime, dans un seul flux de travail agentique. Auparavant, les partenaires devaient jongler entre plusieurs systèmes distincts, ce qui allongeait les cycles de qualification. Les partenaires peuvent désormais connecter leur compte Partner Central, inviter les clients, découvrir les environnements et voir leurs affaires qualifiées plus rapidement, les balises de ressources et les paiements étant appliqués automatiquement selon l'usage réel.
articles.title: AWS Transform now accelerates migration deals for Migration Acceleration Program (MAP) benefits

articles.excerpt: Starting today, Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (Amazon EC2) C8gn instances, powered by the latest-generation AWS Graviton4 processors, are available in the AWS Israel (Tel Aviv) region. The C8gn instances provide up to 30% better compute performance than Graviton3-based Amazon EC2 C7gn instances. Amazon EC2 C8gn instances feature the latest 6th generation AWS Nitro Cards, and offer up to 600 Gbps network bandwidth, the highest network bandwidth among network optimized EC2 instances. Take advantage of the enhanced networking capabilities of C8gn to scale performance and throughput, while optimizing the cost of running network-intensive workloads such as network virtual appliances, data analytics, CPU-based artificial intelligence and machine learning (AI/ML) inference. For increased scalability, C8gn instances offer instance sizes up to 48xlarge, up to 384 GiB of memory, and up to 120 Gbps of bandwidth to Amazon Elastic Block Store (EBS). C8gn instances support Elastic Fabric Adapter (EFA) networking on the 16xlarge, 24xlarge, 48xlarge, metal-24xl, and metal-48xl sizes, which enables lower latency and improved cluster performance for workloads deployed on tightly coupled clusters. C8gn instances are available in the following AWS Regions: US East (N. Virginia, Ohio), US West (Oregon, N.California), Europe (Frankfurt, Stockholm, Ireland, London, Spain, Zurich, Milan, Paris), Asia Pacific (Singapore, Malaysia, Sydney, Thailand, Mumbai, Seoul, Melbourne, Jakarta, Hyderabad…
articles.summary: Les instances Amazon EC2 C8gn, propulsées par les processeurs Graviton4 de dernière génération, sont maintenant disponibles dans la région AWS Israël (Tel Aviv). Selon AWS, elles offrent jusqu'à 30 % de performance de calcul en plus par rapport aux instances C7gn basées sur Graviton3, avec une bande passante réseau allant jusqu'à 600 Gbps. Elles visent notamment les charges réseau intensives, l'analytique de données et l'inférence IA/ML sur CPU.
articles.title: Amazon EC2 C8gn instances are now available in AWS Israel (Tel Aviv) region

articles.excerpt: Starting today, Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (Amazon EC2) C8ine instances are available in the AWS Europe (Ireland) region. C8ine instances are powered by custom sixth generation Intel Xeon Scalable processors, available only on AWS. These instances feature the latest sixth generation AWS Nitro cards, delivering up to 43% higher performance compared to previous generation C6in instances. C8ine instances offer up to 2.5 times higher packet performance per vCPU versus prior generation network optimized instances, providing up to 2x higher network throughput for traffic going through Internet gateways compared to existing C6in network optimized instances. C8ine instances are designed for security and network virtual appliances, including virtual firewalls, load balancers, and Telco 5G UPF workloads. Amazon EC2 C8ine instances are available in US East (N. Virginia), US West (Oregon), Asia Pacific (Tokyo), and Europe (Ireland, Frankfurt) regions. C8ine instances are available via Savings Plans, On-Demand, and Spot instances. For more information, visit the Amazon EC2 C8i instance pages.
articles.summary: Les instances Amazon EC2 C8ine sont désormais disponibles dans la région Europe (Irlande) d'AWS. Propulsées par des processeurs Intel Xeon Scalable de sixième génération propres à AWS, elles offrent jusqu'à 43 % de performance en plus par rapport aux instances C6in, ainsi qu'une performance de paquets par vCPU jusqu'à 2,5 fois supérieure, destinées notamment aux appliances virtuelles de sécurité et de réseau.
articles.title: Amazon EC2 C8ine instances are now available in AWS Europe (Ireland) region

articles.excerpt: Amazon Elastic Container Registry (Amazon ECR) now supports global authentication tokens for private registries. Previously, you needed to request a separate authentication token in each AWS Region where you push or pull container images. Now, you can request a single token from the AWS Sign-In CreateBearerToken API and use it across all ECR private registries in the same AWS partition. Teams that run proxy services to route container pulls across Regions, a common pattern for optimizing latency or availability, previously had to request, refresh, and coordinate a separate token for every Region behind the proxy. With global tokens, the proxy manages one token for all Regions in the AWS partition. Global tokens are valid for 12 hours by default, but can be configured to be as low as 5 minutes. These tokens work with the Docker CLI, and the Amazon ECR Docker Credential Helper. Existing regional authentication tokens continue to work as before. Global authentication tokens are available in all commercial AWS Regions where Amazon ECR is supported. To learn more, see Private registry authentication in the Amazon ECR User Guide .
articles.summary: Amazon ECR accepte désormais des jetons d'authentification globaux pour ses registres privés : un seul jeton, obtenu via l'API CreateBearerToken d'AWS Sign-In, permet d'accéder à tous les registres ECR de la même partition AWS. Cela simplifie notamment les services proxy qui routent les tirages d'images entre régions, qui n'ont plus à gérer un jeton par région. Les jetons durent 12 heures par défaut, configurables jusqu'à 5 minutes, et fonctionnent avec le CLI Docker et le Docker Credential Helper d'ECR; les jetons régionaux existants restent valides.
articles.title: Amazon ECR now supports global authentication tokens for private registries

articles.excerpt: AWS Elemental Inference now lets you customize how it analyzes your live video in two ways. You can create functions that ask custom questions of the video using multi-modal foundational models in Amazon Bedrock, or add contextual metadata decisions using labels and questions you define. Both run on the same pipeline as built-in features such as vertical video creation and smart subtitles, and return results through the GetMetadata API, with no separate pipeline to build. Use contextual metadata decisions when the answer you need fits labels and yes/no questions. You define yes/no questions, such as whether a scene is a weather report, or "pick-one" categories, such as genre. For each scene, contextual metadata returns a decision and a confidence score for every label and question, alongside the standard Interactive Advertising Bureau (IAB), Global Alliance for Responsible Media (GARM), and mood fields, so your workflows can act when confidence meets a threshold you set. No model selection or prompt writing is required. Use functions for open-ended answers, custom response formats, or analysis contextual metadata doesn't cover, such as sponsor logo exposure. A function specifies an Amazon Bedrock model and JSONata expressions that shape the request and response. You attach it to a feed and choose how frequently it runs. Contextual-metadata decisions configuration is included in the contextual metadata price. Functions are available at no additional charge on feeds with at…
articles.summary: AWS Elemental Inference permet désormais de personnaliser l'analyse de vidéo en direct de deux façons : des fonctions qui posent des questions personnalisées à l'aide de modèles fondamentaux multimodaux d'Amazon Bedrock, et des décisions de métadonnées contextuelles basées sur des étiquettes et des questions définies par l'utilisateur. Les résultats sont renvoyés via l'API GetMetadata, sur le même pipeline que les fonctions intégrées comme le format vertical et les sous-titres intelligents. Les décisions de métadonnées contextuelles, incluses dans leur prix, conviennent aux réponses oui/non ou à des catégories, avec un score de confiance pour chaque scène.
articles.title: Customize AWS Elemental Inference with custom models, prompts, and decisions

articles.excerpt: Today, AWS Security Hub adds installed software and resource usage as signals for resource criticality, which indicates how important a resource is to your business. Security Hub uses criticality to rank exposure findings, so that central security teams can prioritize the exposures that affect their most important resources. Security Hub already infers criticality from resource tags and names, but inconsistently tagged resources often have an Unknown criticality, which makes their exposures harder to prioritize. With installed software and resource usage as additional signals, more of your resources receive a meaningful criticality with no tagging or configuration required. For example, an EC2 instance that runs a database engine and serves steady traffic receives a higher criticality than an instance that runs only monitoring agents and sits idle. These signals are included with the Security Hub Essentials plan at no additional cost and require no new enablement. To learn more, see Resources in Security Hub in the AWS Security Hub User Guide and the AWS Security Hub product page . For a list of AWS Regions where Security Hub is available, see the AWS Region table .
articles.summary: AWS Security Hub ajoute maintenant les logiciels installés et l'utilisation des ressources comme signaux pour déterminer la criticité des ressources, afin de mieux classer les constats d'exposition. Les ressources mal étiquetées, dont la criticité était inconnue, reçoivent ainsi davantage d'évaluations significatives sans configuration requise. Ces signaux sont inclus dans le forfait Security Hub Essentials, sans frais supplémentaires ni nouvelle activation.
articles.title: AWS Security Hub now infers resource criticality from installed software and usage

articles.excerpt: Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Memory now lets you keep short-term memory events for up to 10 years, up from one year. Developers can now use short-term memory as a long-lived record of agent conversations and interactions. This helps when that history needs to stay available for a long time, such as for compliance and audit, for users who come back after months away, or for agents that need to look back at past sessions. You set retention on the memory resource, and it's applied to each event when the event is created, so existing events keep their original retention. Standard short-term memory storage charges apply for as long as you keep the data. This feature is available in all AWS Regions where AgentCore Memory is available. To get started, see the AgentCore Memory documentation .
articles.summary: Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Memory permet désormais de conserver les événements de mémoire à court terme jusqu'à 10 ans, contre un an auparavant. La rétention se configure sur la ressource mémoire et s'applique à chaque événement au moment de sa création, les événements existants gardant leur durée initiale. Des frais de stockage standard s'appliquent tant que les données sont conservées, et la fonctionnalité est offerte dans toutes les régions où AgentCore Memory est disponible.
articles.title: Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Memory now supports short-term memory retention of up to 10 years

articles.excerpt: Amazon API Gateway now offers a native JWT authorizer for REST APIs, a new authorizer type that validates JSON Web Tokens directly in the gateway. Until now, validating tokens from an OpenID Connect or OAuth 2.0 identity provider other than Amazon Cognito required a Lambda authorizer. You now configure token validation instead of writing and operating code for it. You can define one or more issuers, the audiences accepted for each, the signing algorithms you permit, and any additional claims a token may present. API Gateway verifies each token's signature, issuer, audience, expiry, and claims on every request. You can attach one authorizer to many methods and require different scopes on each. This fits machine-to-machine APIs, mobile and web backends, and multi-tenant APIs that accept tokens from several identity providers. The JWT authorizer works on Regional, edge-optimized, and private REST APIs, and is available in all commercial AWS Regions and the AWS GovCloud (US) Regions. To get started, see Amazon API Gateway documentation and AWS blog post .
articles.summary: Amazon API Gateway propose désormais un autorisateur JWT natif pour les API REST, qui valide directement dans la passerelle les jetons issus de fournisseurs OpenID Connect ou OAuth 2.0 autres qu'Amazon Cognito, sans passer par un autorisateur Lambda. La configuration permet de définir les émetteurs, les audiences, les algorithmes de signature et les revendications acceptés, la signature, l'émetteur, l'audience, l'expiration et les revendications étant vérifiés à chaque requête. La fonctionnalité est offerte sur les API régionales, edge-optimized et privées, dans toutes les régions commerciales d'AWS et dans les régions AWS GovCloud (US).
articles.title: Amazon API Gateway REST APIs now support JWT authorizers

articles.excerpt: Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Memory now keeps a full session summary for every session. It's a single record that gives a snapshot of what happened in the conversation. Summary chunks cover the conversation in more detail, while the full session summary captures the overall picture of where the session stands. AgentCore Memory updates it as new events arrive, so it always reflects the session so far. This works well for developers who want a quick recap rather than a play-by-play. Full session summaries come with the summary strategy and need no extra setup. Every memory that has a summary strategy gets them automatically, including existing sessions. Each summary is stored as a long-term memory record next to the session's summary chunks. You retrieve it with the Memory operations you already use, and you can filter by record type to return only full session summaries. This feature is available in all AWS Regions where AgentCore Memory is available. To get started, see the Summary strategy documentation .
articles.summary: AWS ajoute à Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Memory un résumé complet de session pour chaque session, mis à jour au fil des nouveaux événements. Il est fourni automatiquement avec la stratégie de résumé, sans configuration supplémentaire, y compris pour les sessions existantes, et est récupérable avec les opérations habituelles en filtrant par type d'enregistrement. La fonctionnalité est offerte dans toutes les régions où AgentCore Memory est disponible.
articles.title: Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Memory now provides full session summaries

articles.excerpt: Building high-quality training datasets has traditionally required weeks of manual labeling and data cleaning. Amazon SageMaker now offers AI data preparation capabilities that help data scientists and ML engineers build high-quality training and evaluation datasets for both text-based model customization and traditional ML. Teams can generate synthetic examples grounded in their own documents, auto-label records at scale with confidence scores, incorporate expert feedback through human review, evaluate data quality, and transform data for their chosen training or evaluation technique. Synthetic data generation creates training, evaluation, and test data from a specification grounded in your documents. Auto-labeling labels data at scale with built-in task types including classification, named entity recognition, extractive question answering, ordinal rating, and summarization, plus custom tasks. Data quality evaluation finds duplicates and surfaces issues such as tone and insufficient diversity with both quality metrics and rules. Data transformation cleans and reshapes data for your training or evaluation technique, using operators such as dedupe, filter, and format conversion. articles.summary: Amazon SageMaker propose désormais des capacités de préparation de données par IA pour construire des jeux de données d'entraînement et d'évaluation de haute qualité, pour la personnalisation de modèles textuels comme pour le ML traditionnel. articles.title: Amazon SageMaker now supports AI data preparation capabilities to build high-quality datasets for model development

articles.excerpt: AWS Lambda now supports scale to and from zero for Event Functions running on Lambda Managed Instances (LMI). Lambda automatically scales execution environments for your function to zero during idle periods and scales them back up when requests arrive, without requiring you to provision minimum capacity. This makes LMI cost-effective for intermittent workloads such as asynchronous processing, development, and test environments. Lambda Managed Instances lets you run Lambda functions on your Amazon EC2 instances while maintaining the operational simplicity of Lambda. With Lambda Managed Instances, you can access specialized compute configurations and drive cost efficiency through EC2 pricing advantages, without managing infrastructure. Previously, customers needed to keep a minimum number of execution environments running even when there was no traffic. With this launch, Lambda scales execution environments for your function to zero after a period with no activity, and provisions them again when requests arrive. This improves cost efficiency for workloads with periods of no traffic. This feature is available today in all AWS commercial Regions where Lambda Managed Instances is available. To get started, set MinExecutionEnvironments to zero for your function using the Lambda console, AWS CLI, AWS SDKs, AWS CloudFormation, AWS SAM, or AWS CDK. To learn more, visit the AWS Lambda Developer Guide and AWS Lambda pricing .
articles.summary: AWS Lambda permet désormais de faire varier à zéro le nombre d'environnements d'exécution des fonctions Event exécutées sur Lambda Managed Instances, sans capacité minimale provisionnée. Les environnements sont réduits à zéro pendant les périodes d'inactivité puis reprovisionnés à l'arrivée de requêtes, ce qui rend l'option plus économique pour les charges intermittentes. La fonctionnalité est offerte dans toutes les régions commerciales AWS où Lambda Managed Instances est disponible et se configure via MinExecutionEnvironments.
articles.title: AWS Lambda now supports scale to and from zero for Lambda Managed Instances

articles.excerpt: Today, AWS announces the general availability of DynamoDB caching with Amazon ElastiCache Serverless for Valkey, a serverless alternative to Amazon DynamoDB Accelerator (DAX) that delivers sub-millisecond read latency for frequently accessed DynamoDB data. Previously, if you needed faster reads than the single-digit millisecond latency of DynamoDB, you had to provision and scale DAX nodes or run your own cache and keep it in sync with DynamoDB. Now you can access DynamoDB table data from a write-through cache that updates as data changes and scales automatically to meet changing workload demands, with no clusters or nodes to manage. DynamoDB caching requires no application logic changes and minimal configuration. You choose which DynamoDB tables and APIs to cache and how long to retain cached data. Your application's IAM credentials are used to access DynamoDB, so existing access control policies are automatically applied. DynamoDB caching is available in all commercial and AWS GovCloud (US) Regions. DynamoDB caching is offered at no additional cost, so you pay only for the ElastiCache Serverless and DynamoDB resources your applications use. To get started, see the ElastiCache Developer Guide .
articles.summary: AWS annonce la disponibilité générale de la mise en cache DynamoDB avec Amazon ElastiCache Serverless pour Valkey, une alternative sans serveur à DAX offrant une latence de lecture inférieure à la milliseconde. Le cache en écriture simultanée se met à jour automatiquement et s'adapte à la charge, sans grappes ni nœuds à gérer, et ne nécessite que peu de configuration et aucune modification de la logique applicative. La fonctionnalité est offerte sans frais supplémentaires et est disponible dans toutes les régions commerciales et dans AWS GovCloud (US).
articles.title: Amazon DynamoDB caching is now available with Amazon ElastiCache Serverless for Valkey

articles.excerpt: Amazon OpenSearch Serverless now supports ingest pipelines, so you can clean, enrich, and vectorize documents inside your collection as they are indexed, without running separate preprocessing infrastructure. For semantic and AI search, you can chunk long text with text_chunking and generate embeddings at ingest time with text_embedding, text_image_embedding, and sparse_encoding. The ml_inference processor calls any model you have connected and lets you map its input and output fields yourself. You create and manage pipelines with the familiar OpenSearch _ingest/pipeline APIs. You can test a pipeline against sample documents with the _simulate API before sending it live traffic, then apply it as an index's default pipeline or on individual indexing and bulk requests. Pipeline processing uses your collection's indexing OpenSearch Compute Units (OCUs) and is billed the same way as other indexing activity. articles.summary: Amazon OpenSearch Serverless prend désormais en charge les pipelines d'ingestion, qui permettent de nettoyer, enrichir et vectoriser les documents pendant leur indexation, sans infrastructure de prétraitement distincte. Les processeurs disponibles couvrent la normalisation (lowercase, trim, rename, etc.), le découpage de texte et la génération d'embeddings, ainsi que l'appel de modèles connectés via ml_inference. Le traitement consomme les OCU d'indexation de la collection, et l'inférence d'un modèle distant est facturée séparément par son fournisseur.
articles.title: Amazon OpenSearch Serverless now supports ingest pipelines

When you deploy one, you choose a framework, and AWS Config evaluates your resources against it. AWS keeps the pack up to date as things change. When new AWS Config managed rules map to the framework's controls, or when the framework itself is revised, AWS updates your deployed pack automatically. Because AWS maintains a consistent pack definition in every supported Region, you can deploy the same framework across Regions without building or maintaining Region-specific rule sets. With managed conformance packs you no longer have to track framework changes or update rules yourself. Previously, to evaluate resources against a framework such as PCI DSS or SOC 2, you started from a sample conformance pack template, customized it for your environment, and then updated it yourself whenever new rules became available or the framework changed. Managed conformance packs remove that work, so your coverage stays current without manual template changes. articles.summary: AWS Config propose désormais des conformance packs gérés, des ensembles de règles construits et maintenus par AWS pour des cadres de conformité donnés. Statement statistics measure every successful statement rather than sampling activity. Use them to find the statements that take the most time, run most often, or cost the most. articles.title: Amazon Aurora DSQL now offers SQL statement statistics in Database Insights

articles.excerpt: AWS now offers a 99.999% availability service level agreement (SLA) for cross-Region traffic over Amazon Virtual Private Cloud (Amazon VPC) cross-Region peering, AWS Transit Gateway, and AWS Cloud WAN, with a new capability called Multipath Resilience. Multipath Resilience makes it easier to improve the resilience of mission-critical applications that send traffic across Regions, such as payment processing, financial trading, telephony, and live media streaming. The AWS backbone is highly resilient and connects Regions over physically diverse fiber paths. When a path fails, such as during a fiber cut, the network's automatic sub-second rerouting moves traffic to a healthy path. In the rare event that such mechanisms do not resolve the issue in a timely manner, such as when there's a partial degradation, it might take minutes for connectivity to be reestablished. Some applications, such as payment processing, financial trading, telephony, and live media streaming, can't tolerate single-digit seconds interruptions, let alone minutes of unavailability. Until now, customers running these applications relied on workarounds, including modifying their applications and operating systems to split a single connection into multiple connections, or replicating data into every Region to avoid cross-Region calls. These workarounds add complexity and don't always work, because applications can't control which network paths their traffic takes. Now, when you turn on Multipath Resilience…

With Advisor, administrators can investigate a WorkSpace from the console and, in minutes, see the likely root cause and recommended actions they can take right away. Since then, we've continued to invest in Advisor so your team can spend less time chasing down issues one by one, and more time on the projects your business is counting on you to deliver. Today, we're excited to announce the preview of proactive troubleshooting in WorkSpaces Advisor, which moves your team from reacting to individual tickets to staying ahead of issues across your whole environment. Advisor can identify issues across your WorkSpaces, explain the likely cause of each one and recommend a fix. You don't need to start an investigation, wait for a user to report a problem, or set alarm thresholds first. If the same problem affects many WorkSpaces, Advisor will show it as a single issue with the likely cause and a recommended fix. Your team fixes the root cause once instead of chasing the same symptom…

articles.excerpt: Amazon API Gateway now offers a native JWT authorizer for REST APIs, a new authorizer type that validates JSON Web Tokens directly in the gateway. articles.excerpt: Amazon S3 now records the TLS key exchange algorithm in AWS CloudTrail for S3 requests, so you can see which requests and clients use post-quantum TLS (PQ-TLS). With this visibility, you can measure the share of your S3 traffic that is protected with post-quantum cryptography, and identify the applications, SDK versions, and IAM principals that still connect with classical key exchange and need to be upgraded. The new keyExchange value in the tlsDetails field of CloudTrail management and data events shows the key exchange negotiated on each TLS connection, such as the hybrid post-quantum algorithm X25519MLKEM768 or a traditional algorithm such as x25519. For example, you can query your CloudTrail logs to find the user agents of S3 requests that did not use ML-KEM, then prioritize those clients for your post-quantum migration. The keyExchange value is recorded for requests to general purpose buckets, directory buckets, table buckets, and vector buckets, including requests made through AWS PrivateLink. Key exchange details for S3 requests are available in all AWS Regions at no additional cost. Standard AWS CloudTrail pricing applies for S3 data events. articles.title: Amazon S3 now provides post-quantum TLS visibility in AWS CloudTrail

articles.excerpt: Amazon S3 adds post-quantum TLS (PQ-TLS) key exchange support to S3 Vectors and AWS PrivateLink for Amazon S3 interface endpoints. This extends the post-quantum cryptography support already available on regional S3, S3 Tables, and S3 Express One Zone endpoints. S3 Vectors endpoints and PrivateLink interface endpoints now support Module-Lattice-Based Key-Encapsulation Mechanism (ML-KEM), one of the National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) standardized post-quantum cryptographic algorithms. PQ-TLS key exchange is available to all clients configured to use the ML-KEM key exchange algorithm. S3 Vectors and PrivateLink endpoints automatically negotiate the strongest key exchange that your client software supports, so clients that support ML-KEM receive the benefits of PQ-TLS key exchange without any changes to your applications or endpoint configuration. PQ-TLS key exchange for S3 Vectors and AWS PrivateLink for S3 is supported at no additional cost in all AWS Regions. To learn more about PQ-TLS support in S3, visit the Amazon S3 User Guide .
articles.title: Amazon S3 adds post-quantum TLS key exchange support to additional S3 endpoints

articles.excerpt: Amazon SageMaker HyperPod introduces cluster operations, giving you visibility into every scaling and on-demand deep health check request from submission to completion. When a request runs into errors, the SageMaker AI console shows an alert that links directly to that request's error events. With continuous provisioning, HyperPod brings capacity online in the background as it becomes available, retries failed nodes automatically, and lets you run multiple scaling requests at the same time. Cluster operations show you when each request finishes and which request caused the activity on your cluster. When a scale-up falls short of its target, you can go directly to the failure reason. Each scaling or on-demand deep health check request creates a cluster operation that tracks the request from submission to completion, including whether it is still in progress and what it changed on each instance group. Events that HyperPod records while working on the request are linked to its operation. For example, if a scale-up of your training instance group doesn't reach its target, you can open the operation and see only the events for that request, without sorting through unrelated cluster activity. If you or an autoscaler such as Karpenter send several requests to the same instance group, for example during a burst of inference traffic, each operation shows whether it completed or was replaced by a newer request. That way you can tell which request actually changed your cluster. After…
articles.title: Amazon SageMaker HyperPod now supports cluster operations for tracking scaling and on-demand Deep Health Check requests

articles.excerpt: Starting today, you can allocate the storage and request costs of a shared Amazon S3 general purpose bucket to the prefixes in that bucket in the AWS Cost and Usage Report (CUR). Organizations often store data for many teams, applications, or tenants in one bucket under different prefixes, such as `marketing/` and `finance/`. Until now, attributing that bucket's bill to each prefix required custom pipelines built on S3 Inventory or Storage Lens reports and your own pricing logic. With Split Cost Allocation Data for Amazon S3, Amazon S3 Storage Lens publishes prefix-level storage and request metrics to AWS Billing and Cost Management, which allocates the bucket's storage and Tier 1 and Tier 2 request costs to the deepest matching prefix in the range of prefix levels you choose. Each prefix line item carries its full prefix path as AWS-generated cost allocation tags, so you can total cost by top-level prefix, team, or application, and reconcile it back to the bucket. You can use this data for chargeback, showback, and to see which prefixes drive your S3 spend. To get started, enable AWS Billing and Cost Management publishing in an S3 Storage Lens advanced tier dashboard configuration, then enable split cost allocation data for Amazon S3 in the AWS Billing and Cost Management console. Prefix cost data appears in your CUR after the next daily Storage Lens metrics are published. Split Cost Allocation Data for Amazon S3 is available in all AWS commercial Regions where S3 Storage…
articles.title: AWS Split Cost Allocation Data now supports Amazon S3

articles.excerpt: Amazon Route 53 Resolver DNS Firewall now automatically generates domain allow-lists from your VPCs' observed DNS query traffic, helping you enforce least-privilege DNS access and reduce the risk of DNS-based data exfiltration. Previously, implementing a least-privilege model required security teams to manually analyze DNS query logs to identify the domains their VPCs depend on before deploying allow-list rules. This created operational overhead and delayed enforcement of a deny-by-default (walled-garden) posture. With automated allow-list generation, DNS Firewall analyzes DNS query traffic using a lookback window configurable from 1 hour to 7 days to create an allow-list of observed domains. It then continuously monitors DNS queries and flags newly observed domains, so you can review them before adding them to the allow-list. You can deploy the rule across multiple VPCs and accounts using AWS Firewall Manager or Route 53 Profiles. This capability is available at no additional cost to DNS Firewall Advanced customers, in all AWS Regions where Route 53 DNS Firewall is supported, except in AWS GovCloud (US) and Amazon Web Services China Regions. To get started, use the Route 53 DNS Firewall console, AWS CLI, or API. To learn more, visit the Amazon Route 53 Resolver DNS Firewall product page and the Route 53 DNS Firewall Developer Guide .
articles.title: Amazon Route 53 Resolver DNS Firewall now supports automated allow-list generation

articles.excerpt: Amazon Kinesis Data Streams now supports queues, a simpler and more cost-effective way to process a stream. Because queues track the delivery state of each record, your consumer instances receive records instead of leasing shards, acknowledge each record when processing is complete, and scale beyond the number of shards. Kinesis Data Streams consumers can reduce the cost of processing data by up to 43% by using queues instead of the Kinesis Client Library. You no longer run a DynamoDB table or custom metrics, and you use compute more efficiently. Queues in Kinesis Data Streams are powered by Amazon SQS. Built on that foundation, a queue delivers records at least once, redelivers records your consumers do not acknowledge, and provides built-in dead-letter handling for records that keep failing. Each queue publishes its own CloudWatch metrics, so you can scale consumer instances on records waiting to be received and alarm on records that repeatedly fail. Use queues for applications that process each record independently, such as log processing, order fulfillment, and notifications. Use a stream consumer when processing one record depends on the records before it, such as live analytics, personalization, and anomaly detection. You ingest data once and let each application consume records through a queue or directly from the stream, with no change to your producers or existing stream consumers. For point-to-point messaging between application components, start with Amazon SQS.…
articles.title: Amazon Kinesis Data Streams announces queues to simplify and reduce costs of real-time processing

articles.excerpt: Amazon Connect Customer message templates, which personalize each message with details about its recipient, now support case fields from Cases and calculated attributes from Customer Profiles, such as a customer's most frequent contact channel. Companies that send updates about a claim, an order, or an application need each message to reflect that customer's record. Template authors can insert case fields, including custom fields that administrators define, and Connect Customer fills in the current value for each recipient every time it sends a message that uses the template. A claims manager at an insurance company can build one email template that pulls each claim's reference number and status from its case, so every policyholder receives an update about their own claim. A retailer can add a custom calculated attribute, such as each customer's total orders in the past year, to a loyalty email so every customer sees their own count. Developers can pass these values when they render a template with the RenderMessageTemplate API. You can use case and calculated attributes in message templates in the following AWS Regions: US East (N. Virginia), US West (Oregon), Africa (Cape Town), Asia Pacific (Seoul), Asia Pacific (Singapore), Asia Pacific (Sydney), Asia Pacific (Tokyo), Canada (Central), Europe (Frankfurt), and Europe (London). To learn more, see Add personalized content to message templates in the Amazon Connect Customer Administrator Guide.
articles.title: Amazon Connect Customer now supports case and calculated template variables

articles.excerpt: AWS Cost Optimization Hub now lets you stop idle Amazon EC2 instances directly from your recommendations. Cost Optimization Hub consolidates and prioritizes cost optimization recommendations across your AWS accounts and Regions, including idle resources. Previously, stopping an idle instance required you to leave Cost Optimization Hub and identify the specific instance in the Amazon EC2 console. Now you can stop it from the Savings opportunities page in Cost Optimization Hub. When you choose Stop next to an idle instance recommendation, a confirmation shows the instance, its account and Region, what the instance loses when it stops, such as instance store data and data in memory, and what continues to bill, such as EBS volumes and Elastic IP addresses. Stopping does not terminate the instance or delete its EBS volumes, and you can start it again from the EC2 console. Stop needs no separate setup and uses your existing permissions. To receive idle resource recommendations, turn on Cost Optimization Hub and AWS Compute Optimizer. This feature is available at no additional charge in all AWS Regions except the AWS GovCloud (US) Regions and the China Regions. To get started, open Cost Optimization Hub in the AWS Billing and Cost Management console and go to Savings opportunities. To learn more, see the Cost Optimization Hub product page and user guide .
articles.title: Cost Optimization Hub now supports stopping idle Amazon EC2 instances

articles.excerpt: AWS now enables agentic coding harnesses to open the new AWS sign-up experience for developers who don't have an AWS account yet. articles.excerpt: With AWS Elemental MediaConnect , you now have more protocol support and routing control for your live video workflows. First, MediaConnect now supports more protocols, including RTMP, RTMPS, and eRTMP, across both flows and router . RTMP is widely used by live streaming encoders and software such as OBS. With this support, you can now bring RTMP sources into MediaConnect and deliver to RTMP endpoints, such as social and live streaming platforms. Second, the service adds three new routing capabilities: - PID remapping on MediaConnect router reassigns transport stream PIDs inline, without transcoding. - Clean switch aligns input transitions on video boundaries for a more seamless switching experience. - SRT merge input mode bonds redundant SRT streams of the same content, reconstructing a clean feed when one path degrades to add resilience for lossy or long-haul contribution. These capabilities are available in all AWS Regions where MediaConnect Router is available. To learn more, see the AWS Elemental MediaConnect documentation .
articles.title: AWS Elemental MediaConnect expands routing control and protocol support

articles.excerpt: AWS Lambda durable functions now lets you pause a running durable execution and resume it later without losing its progress. When you resume an execution, it continues from its last checkpoint on the same function version. By default, time spent paused doesn't count toward the execution timeout. You can also now delete a completed execution's data before its retention period ends. With Lambda durable functions, you can build resilient multi-step applications and AI workflows that run for up to one year, with built-in checkpointing and automatic retries. With this launch, when a downstream service is degraded or a model provider's rate limit is reached, you can pause affected executions while you resolve the issue instead of letting the retries run out. You can also delete an execution's history, checkpoint data, and input and output payloads after it succeeds, fails, stops, or times out. For example, you can delete an execution whose input contains personal data, or clean up failed executions that a bug left behind. You can pause, resume, and delete executions using the Lambda console, the AWS CLI, or the AWS SDKs in all AWS Regions where AWS Lambda durable functions is available. This enables organizations with hybrid networks to resolve DNS queries to public and private domains over existing AWS Direct Connect or AWS VPN connections, with automatic multi-region failover for high availability. articles.excerpt: The open source AWS Workload Credentials Provider can now export AWS Certificate Manager (ACM) certificates to applications running in containers on Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS), including AWS Fargate, Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS), and Docker on Amazon EC2. You can now automate certificate deployment and renewal for containerized TLS workloads the same way you do on EC2 instances, on both Linux and Windows. The provider runs as a sidecar in your ECS task or EKS pod. It exports each certificate and private key to a shared volume and writes the renewed files when ACM rotates the certificate. For TLS servers that don't reload certificate files on their own, such as NGINX, Apache, HAProxy, or IIS, a companion watcher in the TLS container runs your reload command after each renewal. The watcher needs no AWS credentials. TLS servers that reload automatically, such as Envoy, Traefik, and Caddy, need only the shared volume. Access is controlled through IAM: the sidecar assumes a per-workload role that is allowed to export only that workload's certificates. To get started, download the provider and watcher binaries for Linux (x86_64 and Arm64) or Windows, and follow the setup steps and ECS and EKS examples in the AWS Workload Credentials Provider README on GitHub. articles.excerpt: Today, AWS WAF announces a simplified console experience for Bot Control at the targeted inspection level. A single setting, Targeted bot control, turns on targeted protection for your Amazon CloudFront distributions with the configuration AWS recommends. It comes with two additions to the Bot Control managed rule group: bot confidence levels, which summarize the targeted detections on each request as High, Medium, or Low, and a LATEST version that keeps you on the newest detections automatically. articles.summary: Le secrétaire à la Défense Pete Hegseth a effectué mercredi une visite surprise à Caracas. Le titre annonce également un accord de coopération militaire entre le Pentagone et le Venezuela, dont l'extrait ne précise pas la teneur.

articles.group_summary: Grand Theft Auto VI est lancé dans le monde et reçoit des critiques très élogieuses. Le Devoir le décrit comme un projet monumental et invite les lecteurs à poser leurs questions à un journaliste qui l'a joué.
articles.group_title: Sortie de Grand Theft Auto VI

articles.excerpt: Le BEI avait mené l’enquête sur l’intervention mortelle survenue à Salluit en 2024.
articles.summary: Le Bureau des enquêtes indépendantes (BEI) n'portera aucune accusation contre les policiers impliqués dans l'intervention mortelle qui a visé les jumeaux Papigatuk. Cette intervention a eu lieu à Salluit en 2024, et le BEI en a mené l'enquête.
articles.title: Pas d’accusations contre les policiers qui ont tiré sur les jumeaux Papigatuk

articles.excerpt: Tanya Lalonde et son enfant sont morts quand le poids lourd a embouti leur voiture, en août 2025, sur la Rive-Sud de Montréal.
articles.group_summary: La SQ a arrêté le camionneur impliqué dans la collision mortelle sur l'autoroute 30, qui a tué une mère et son enfant en août 2025. Il fait face à des accusations de conduite dangereuse causant la mort.
articles.group_title: Arrestation du camionneur du carambolage de l'A-30
articles.summary: Un camionneur a été arrêté plus d'un an après une collision sur l'A-30, sur la Rive-Sud de Montréal, qui a tué une mère, Tanya Lalonde, et son enfant. Le poids lourd a embouti leur voiture en août 2025.
articles.title: Un camionneur arrêté plus d’un an après la collision ayant tué une mère et son fils sur l’A-30

articles.excerpt: Un nouveau groupe anonyme veut un «débordement de la grève hors des murs des cégeps et des universités».
articles.summary: Un groupe anonyme nouvellement apparu a vandalisé la station de métro Université-de-Montréal afin de faire perdurer la grève étudiante. Il souhaite que la grève déborde au-delà des cégeps et des universités.
articles.title: La station de métro Université-de-Montréal vandalisée pour faire «perdurer» la grève étudiante

articles.title: Vous aimeriez en savoir plus sur le jeu «Grand Theft Auto VI»?

articles.excerpt: Le Centre québécois du droit de l’environnement et 8 citoyens l’accusent de violer la loi, les Chartes et l’Accord de Paris.
articles.summary: Le Centre québécois du droit de l'environnement et huit citoyens poursuivent le gouvernement du Québec en justice. Ils l'accusent d'avoir violé la loi, les Chartes et l'Accord de Paris en reportant la cible de réduction des émissions de gaz à effet de serre de 2030.
articles.title: Québec attaqué en justice pour sa décision de reporter la cible d’émissions de GES de 2030

articles.title: Vision de l’avenir de deux lauréats du prix Turing face à une IA en croissance

articles.title: Les rentes de retraite au Québec augmenteront de 2,7% en janvier

articles.summary: Un capitaine de cadets affirme être paralysé de la taille vers le bas à la suite d'une agression survenue alors qu'il distribuait des coquelicots du jour du Souvenir. Le reste des détails n'est pas disponible, l'extrait étant absent.
articles.title: Cadet captain says he's paralyzed from waist down after attack while distributing Remembrance Day poppies

articles.excerpt: Saqijuq's Mobile Intervention Team (MIT) in Kuujjuaq is pairing intervention workers with officers in an effort to reduce police involvement, arrests and use of force. It comes on the heels of years of distrust between Inuit and the Nunavik Police Service.
articles.summary: L'équipe d'intervention mobile Saqijuq à Kuujjuaq associe des intervenants à des policiers afin de réduire le recours à la police, les arrestations et l'usage de la force. Cette initiative vient après des années de méfiance entre les Inuits et le Service de police du Nunavik.
articles.title: Fatal police shootings in Nunavik shattered trust. Can these new intervention teams help?

articles.excerpt: Doctors and patients say a diagnostic wait time crisis is putting people's lives at risk, as the highest number of Manitobans on record wait for scans that help diagnose brain tumours, heart disease and other potentially deadly medical conditions.
articles.summary: Des médecins et des patients affirment que les délais d'attente pour les examens diagnostiques au Manitoba mettent des vies en danger. Le nombre de Manitobains en attente de scans servant à diagnostiquer des tumeurs cérébrales, des maladies cardiaques et d'autres affections potentiellement mortelles est le plus élevé jamais enregistré.
articles.title: Wait for the most common diagnostic scans in Manitoba 'worse now than it ever has been': doctor

articles.excerpt: Justice Vikas Khaladkar roundly rejected a bail proposal from a man who texted the sister of his former intimate partner, saying: "I’ll get bail. This is Canada. She’ll be with me by the end of the day.”
articles.summary: Le juge Vikas Khaladkar, à Terre-Neuve-et-Labrador, a catégoriquement rejeté une demande de mise en liberté sous caution d'un homme qui avait écrit à la sœur de son ancienne partenaire intime, affirmant qu'il obtiendrait sa libération et qu'elle serait avec lui avant la fin de la journée. L'homme s'était vanté de la facilité avec laquelle on sort de prison au Canada.
articles.title: ‘Not anymore’: N.L. judge denies bail to man who bragged about Canada's easy release

articles.excerpt: Newfoundland and Labrador will give retailers at least six months from when the current sitting of the House of Assembly wraps up, but intends to see flavoured vape products removed from store shelves.
articles.summary: Terre-Neuve-et-Labrador prévoit interdire les produits de vapotage aromatisés et veut les retirer des tablettes des commerces. Les détaillants auront au moins six mois, à compter de la fin de la session en cours de l'Assemblée législative. Le titre indique que le projet résulte d'un travail de longue date, selon la médecin en chef de la province.
articles.title: Proposed flavoured vape ban 'years in the making,' says N.L.'s top doctor

articles.excerpt: A paper published this month in Nature Methods relied on sound recordings and artificial intelligence to identify individual birds based on their songs alone.
articles.summary: Un article publié ce mois-ci dans Nature Methods décrit une méthode qui utilise des enregistrements sonores et l'intelligence artificielle pour identifier des oiseaux individuels uniquement à partir de leur chant. Le résumé fourni ne précise pas les espèces étudiées ni les résultats détaillés.
articles.title: Biologists are using AI to track individual birds by their songs alone

articles.excerpt: Body cameras can be a valuable source of evidence for the justice system, but it gives legal professionals a lot of extra footage to review. The head of the province’s Crown Attorney Association says there’s not enough resources for prosecutors to process body camera footage.
articles.summary: Un procureur de la Couronne senior avertit que les caméras corporelles, utiles comme source de preuve, génèrent beaucoup de vidéos supplémentaires à visionner pour le système de justice. Le président de l'association provinciale des procureurs de la Couronne affirme que les ressources sont insuffisantes pour traiter ces enregistrements.
articles.title: Body cam footage could overload the justice system, warns senior Crown prosecutor

articles.excerpt: The store's ownership group says the trio were attempting to shoplift $2,600 of groceries.
articles.summary: Trois personnes ont été accusées après une agression qui a envoyé un employé de 20 ans de Save-On-Foods à l'hôpital. Selon le groupe propriétaire du magasin, les trois suspects tentaient de voler pour 2 600 $ d'épicerie.
articles.title: 3 charged after attack sends 20-year-old Save-On-Foods employee to hospital

articles.excerpt: The gaming industry might not be the first place to look for military procurement advice, but a recently released video game offers a subtle suggestion for what Canada should pick for its new fighter jet fleet.
articles.summary: Un jeu vidéo récemment sorti semble suggérer discrètement quel avion de combat le Canada devrait choisir pour renouveler sa flotte. L'extrait ne précise ni le jeu ni l'avion recommandé.
articles.title: Oddly enough, this video game weighs in on Canada's fighter jet options

articles.excerpt: Police say injuries are not life-threatening and cleanup is underway.
articles.summary: Un train du Canadien National a déraillé et est tombé dans la rivière Skeena, près de Terrace, en Colombie-Britannique. Deux personnes ont été hospitalisées, et la police indique que leurs blessures ne menacent pas le pronostic vital. Le nettoyage est en cours.
articles.title: 2 hospitalized after CN Rail train derails into Skeena River near Terrace, B.C.

articles.excerpt: Edmonton Elks players hoisted a sign saying “City of Champions” in front of thousands of fans wearing green and gold at the Expo Centre on Tuesday evening to celebrate the football club’s first Grey Cup championship since 2015.
articles.summary: Les Elks d'Edmonton ont célébré leur première coupe Grey Cup depuis 2015, lors d'une fête tenue mardi soir au Expo Centre devant des milliers de partisans vêtus de vert et d'or. Les joueurs ont brandi une pancarte portant la mention « City of Champions ».
articles.title: Elks celebrate 1st Grey Cup championship in more than a decade

articles.excerpt: Canada's National Public Alerting System is running tests of its Alert Ready system Wednesday across all provinces and territories. Alert Ready delivers alerts about critical events such as tornadoes, flooding, fires and Amber alerts.
articles.summary: Le Système national d'alerte publique du Canada effectuera mercredi des essais de son système Alert Ready dans toutes les provinces et tous les territoires. Ce système diffuse des alertes concernant des événements critiques comme les tornades, les inondations, les incendies et les alertes Amber.
articles.title: Canada's national emergency alert system will sound off Wednesday for testing

articles.excerpt: After a Prince Edward Island author won Canada's most prestigious prize for literature, the province's literary community says it could mean more opportunities for writers here at home.
articles.summary: L'auteur de l'Île-du-Prince-Édouard Nicholas Herring a remporté le prix Giller, le plus prestigieux prix littéraire du Canada. Le milieu littéraire de la province y voit une occasion qui pourrait ouvrir davantage de débouchés aux écrivains d'ici.
articles.title: Nicholas Herring's Giller Prize win a 'huge opportunity' for P.E.I. authors, says literary community

articles.excerpt: What started as a joke on a late-night sketch comedy show quickly blew up online in the hours following its airing. It’s garnered more than 11.9 million views on Instagram alone, and shared hundreds of thousands of times.
articles.summary: Une parodie diffusée à l'émission SNL a rapidement fait le tour des réseaux sociaux, avec plus de 11,9 millions de visionnements sur Instagram seulement. Des aidants de la Colombie-Britannique expliquent pourquoi ce sketch les a particulièrement touchés.
articles.title: B.C. caregivers explain why a recent SNL sketch has struck a nerve

articles.excerpt: The federal government is writing off billions of dollars' worth of outstanding debt related to COVID-19 benefits sent to individuals it later deemed ineligible.
articles.summary: Le gouvernement fédéral annule des milliards de dollars de dettes liées à des prestations COVID-19 versées à des personnes jugées inadmissibles par la suite. L'information concerne l'effacement de créances en cours, selon l'extrait disponible.
articles.title: Federal government waives $4.5B debt from COVID-19 benefits sent to ineligible recipients

articles.excerpt: Previous Canadian books featured on Oprah’s Book Club include A Fine Balance by Rohinton Mistry and Fall on Your Knees by Ann-Marie Macdonald.
articles.summary: Oprah Winfrey a choisi un livre d'un auteur né en Ontario comme sa plus récente sélection pour son club de lecture. L'extrait rappelle que d'autres romans canadiens ont déjà été mis en vedette, notamment A Fine Balance de Rohinton Mistry et Fall on Your Knees d'Ann-Marie Macdonald.
articles.title: Oprah Winfrey names book by Ontario-born author as her latest book club pick

articles.excerpt: As Opposition MPs call for more study, the Liberal government has limited debate on its proposed changes to Canada's medical assistance in dying law.
articles.summary: Le gouvernement libéral a limité le débat sur ses modifications proposées à la loi canadienne sur l'aide médicale à mourir. Les députés de l'opposition, dont les conservateurs, réclament davantage d'étude du projet de loi avant son adoption.
articles.title: Liberals limit debate on assisted dying bill as Conservatives call for changes

articles.excerpt: A Calgary high school sent parents a memo this week asking them to rein in their children’s increasing use of food delivery apps like Uber Eats and DoorDash during school hours.
articles.title: Calgary high school says too many students are getting food delivered

articles.excerpt: The community has rallied around two Oromocto Minor Hockey Association teams that fell victim to a phishing scam and lost about $750 each.
articles.summary: Deux équipes de hockey mineur de l'Association de hockey mineur d'Oromocto, au Nouveau-Brunswick, ont été victimes d'une arnaque par hameçonnage et ont perdu environ 750 $ chacune. La communauté se mobilise pour les soutenir.
articles.title: Community rallies around 2 N.B. minor hockey teams who fell victim to phishing scam

digest.text: Une faille critique Java4Shell dans le décodeur Base64 de Java permet l'exécution de code à distance sans authentification, touchant Jenkins, Jira et Keycloak. La CISA et le Centre canadien pour la cybersécurité demandent d'appliquer rapidement les correctifs.

Québecor offre 31 milliards de dollars pour Telus afin de rivaliser avec Bell et Rogers. Mark Carney insiste sur la concurrence, la baisse des prix et le service, et les échanges en Bourse bondissent.

Nvidia dépasse les attentes du troisième trimestre et relève ses prévisions sous une PDG par intérim, Jensen Huang ne devant pas revenir. L'entreprise a cessé de livrer ses puces avancées en Chine, sur fond d'enquêtes.
OpenAI lance GPT-6.2 Astra, son modèle de pointe, et GPT-6.2 Sol dans l'API. Astra coûte 8 $ par million de jetons en entrée, soit 80 % du prix de 6 Astra.

Carney s'engage à élargir le partenariat avec la Chine à l'APEC, avec la levée de restrictions sur le porc et les fruits de mer. Sa brève rencontre avec Trump laisse planer le doute sur un accord sans droits de douane.

Anthropic envisage d'augmenter la taille de son entrée en Bourse devant la forte demande, avec une cotation au Nasdaq sous ANT jeudi. Des géants technologiques écartent par ailleurs les craintes des marchés sur l'IA.

Le paquet PyPI agent-framework de Microsoft a été compromis par deux versions malveillantes volant des identifiants infonuagiques. Les pirates auraient aussi obtenu les identifiants d'administrateur d'une organisation GitHub.
